title: fagopyrum lineare
intro: Fagopyrum lineare, commonly known as Narrow-leaved buckwheat or Japanese buckwheat, is a plant species that belongs to the Polygonaceae family. It is a perennial herb native to East Asia, valued for its edible seeds, leaves, and stems, which offer a range of health benefits. The plant is rich in antioxidants, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Fagopyrum lineare, including rutin, quercetin, and kaempferol, contribute to its potential health benefits, including cardiovascular protection, improved cognitive function, and anti-cancer properties.
